breaking.change: Sharpens with contrast-adaptive sharpening in the tonemap, after depth of field and motion blur, instead of a pass right after TAA (or FSR's RCAS); with PostEffects.sharpen set, the stronger of the two applies once.
breaking.fix: Retune taaSharpen by eye; lower PostEffects.sharpen where both were set to add up.

fixed: GPU crowds cast shadows again into cached shadow layers that no other moving caster reaches.
WebGL2 and GLES devices (no compute) start again: the HDR mip chain's compute downsample and its storage textures are made only where the device has compute.
Cooked assets are cooked again (cooker r36): the overdraw-ordered LODs, single-channel textures and packed ORM maps reach existing projects.
Pre-skinned characters' tangents no longer go wrong on backends that flush subnormal or NaN floats; compact meshes drawn in the meshlet pool keep their shadows and occluder depth.
TAAU no longer leaves a checker in a moving object's wake under a still camera; FSR's shading-change mask is read at its own pixel, not half a pixel off.
Auto exposure meters the same mean on every host, with compute or without.

Grass shows in planar reflections again; GI probes update at their former rate; the underwater sun scatters as before (anisotropy 0.35); occlusion culling starts from 16,384 instances again; local shadow layers keep their full size on High.
Terrain roughness in the depth prepass matches the lit pass (height blending, wetness); scattered plants out of view keep casting long low-sun and shadow-box shadows.

Visibility-buffer surfaces keep puddles off curved crowns; the stylised (quantize, pixel) chain is undithered; depth of field's foreground blur reaches in-focus pixels without a hard edge; froxel fog keeps its history while the game is paused; screen-space reflections apply only where the surface was the one drawn.
Motion vectors and other half-float packs round to nearest instead of toward zero; the pipeline cache is written after the first frame and at exit, not mid-play.
2D lights' shadows draw on devices that cannot render to Rg32Float (the browser's Compat tier): their pipeline was invalid there and every frame with them failed.
Scenes with transmissive (glass) materials no longer stop on a capability assertion: the transmission copy's levels fill by render passes inside the main pass again, which needs no compute.
